research.title: Negation Sensitivity in Extractive Question Answering
bullets: Designed controlled experiments using negated questions and matched affirmative variants to assess answer selection behavior in pretrained extractive models.
Analyzed prediction changes by negation scope, answer location, and lexical overlap, distinguishing unsupported answers from failures to identify relevant passages.

research.title: Cross-Domain Robustness and Calibration in Intent Classification
bullets: Designed cross-domain evaluation protocols comparing lexical and transformer classifiers under vocabulary shifts, with controls for label overlap and training composition.
Analyzed calibration and abstention behavior across domains, examining confidence distributions and error categories to characterize unreliable predictions on unfamiliar requests.

publications.title: Evaluating Vocabulary Shift in Cross-Domain Intent Classification
Confidence Calibration and Selective Prediction for Intent Classification Under Domain Shift

work.title: Document Ingestion and Validation
bullets: Implemented Python routines for document ingestion, metadata validation, and duplicate detection within an existing text processing service.
Maintained unit tests for malformed inputs and encoding inconsistencies, investigated processing failures, and documented fixes for routine service maintenance.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sequence Taggers for Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented conditional random field and bidirectional recurrent sequence taggers for named entity recognition using a shared preprocessing and evaluation pipeline.
Compared entity-level precision and recall across entity types, inspecting boundary errors and unfamiliar tokens to contextualize differences between tagging approaches.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for Passage Search
bullets: Implemented lexical ranking and pretrained sentence embedding retrieval for passage search, using consistent query sets and relevance judgments.
Compared retrieval rankings under paraphrased queries and rare terminology, examining missed passages and lexical distractors through structured error analysis.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Frequency and Graph-Based Ranking
bullets: Implemented frequency-based and graph-based sentence ranking for extractive summarization, applying shared sentence segmentation and summary length constraints.
Compared summaries using reference overlap and manual checks for redundancy, tracing omitted information to sentence scoring and selection behavior.
